msg_type.description: Wire discriminator: names the message type. Added in the Phase 1 edit (2026-09-18); the Phase 0 schemas pinned no discriminator, and service.error already used "message" for human-readable text, so routing on "message" was impossible.

max_frame_bytes.description: Hard frame cap: 1 MiB per JSON-lines frame. Larger frames are rejected with payload_too_large.

negotiated_protocol.description: The protocol version both sides use from here on. The service may negotiate down, never up.

worker_id.description: Service-assigned session id for this worker; informational.
